findings.quote: The President may also suspend the **privilege of the writ of habeas corpus** under those conditions.
findings.problem: The lesson introduces suspension and teaches its limits, but omits that it applies only to persons judicially charged for rebellion or offenses inherent in or directly connected with invasion. It also omits the requirement to charge an arrested or detained person judicially within three days or release that person. These are material limits in Article VII, Section 18; the general invasion-or-rebellion condition and 60-day limit do not explain them.
